title: Gabber relation in a quotient after faithfully flat base change
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings and B a finite A-algebra [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let I be an ideal of A contained in its Jacobson radical. Suppose B/IB is compatibly a product of A/I-algebras B1 and B2, A/I to B1 is surjective, and b maps to (1,0). Then there is a commutative A-algebra C in the universe of A, faithfully flat over A, and d >= 1 such that 1 tensor the class of (b-1)b^d vanishes in C tensor_A (B/N_d). Here N_d is the range of the A-linear map from tuples (i_j) in I, j in Fin(d+1), sending the tuple to the sum i_j b^j.

proof.text: Obtain the faithfully flat algebra C, positive degree d and tensor coefficients from the upstairs coefficient relation. Apply the base change of the quotient map B → B/range L to the tensor equality.

For every j and i in I, the tuple supported only at j with value i maps under L to i*b^j. Hence each coefficient map I → B → B/range L is zero. Functoriality of tensor base change makes each summand zero; linearity and the finite sum give the desired vanishing.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_gabber_relation_after_base_change
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [Module.Finite A B] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥)
    (B₁ : Type w) (B₂ : Type z) [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂]
    [Algebra (A ⧸ I) B₁] [Algebra (A ⧸ I) B₂]
    (e : (B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A B)) ≃+* (B₁ × B₂))
    (he : ∀ a : A, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (algebraMap A B a)) =
      (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) B₁ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a),
        algebraMap (A ⧸ I) B₂ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a)))
    (h₁ : Function.Surjective (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) B₁))
    (b : B) (hb : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap A B)) b) = (1, 0)) :
    ∃ (C : CommRingCat.{u}) (f : A →+* C),
      letI : Algebra A C := f.toAlgebra;
      Module.FaithfullyFlat A C ∧ ∃ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d ∧
        let L : (Fin (d + 1) → I) →ₗ[A] B :=
          ∑ j : Fin (d + 1), (I.subtype.comp (LinearMap.proj j)).smulRight (b ^ (j : ℕ));
        TensorProduct.mk A C (B ⧸ LinearMap.range L) 1
          ((LinearMap.range L).mkQ ((b - 1) * b ^ d)) = 0
